q1.q: Is my new site HIPAA-compliant out of the box?
q1.a: Yes. Forms, hosting and data flows are designed with PHI safety in mind, and a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) is available on request. We also configure analytics to keep protected data out of third-party tools.

q2.q: How long does a typical build take?
q2.a: Most single-practice sites launch in 4 to 6 weeks from kickoff. Multi-location or migration-heavy projects take longer. You'll get a written timeline with milestones before we start.

q3.q: Who owns the website and content after launch?
q3.a: You do — 100%. Code, content, assets, hosting accounts and domain remain fully yours. There's no lock-in and no proprietary CMS to escape.

q4.q: Do you handle migrations from our current site?
q4.a: Yes. We migrate content, redirects, media and SEO equity from WordPress, Squarespace, Wix, or custom stacks — with a redirect map so rankings don't drop.

q5.a: Packages start at $797 and are fully listed on our Pricing page.

q6.q: Do you provide maintenance after launch?
q6.a: Yes. Every launch includes a care plan option covering updates, backups, uptime monitoring, security patches and monthly content changes.

q7.q: Can you work under an NDA?
q7.a: Absolutely. NDAs are standard on every engagement, with scoped access, private workspaces and confidential handling by default.
